name: ax-add-ingest-stage
title_zh: 给 ax 图加 ingest 阶段或 Surreal
tagline_zh: 你刚加完新阶段，CI 却因漏注册而红。这个 skill 把那些藏得极深的注册陷阱直接编码成检查清单，一次过。
tagline_en: Add a new ingest stage or SurrealDB table without the CI red. It encodes the exact registration gotchas that.
desc_en: Use when adding a new ingest stage or a new SurrealDB table to the ax graph. Encodes the exact registration gotchas that fail CI if missed.
why_zh: 不是泛泛的代码生成，而是把 CI 失败的具体原因固化成步骤。它知道哪些遗漏会让流水线在最后一步爆掉。
why_en: Not generic scaffolding—it encodes the precise registration pitfalls that break CI. It knows which omissions blow up late and.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 ax 仓库内 ingest 阶段与 SurrealDB 表的注册逻辑；不处理查询优化、数据迁移或非 ax 项目。
limit_en: Only covers ingest-stage and SurrealDB-table registration inside the ax repo. No query tuning, migrations, or non-ax projects. Won't flag schema.
